tasks.name: Word extraction utility
tasks.spec:
Create src/util.js as an ES module exporting a named function words(input).

Acceptance criteria:
1. words(input) returns an array of the words in the string input, where a word is a maximal run of ASCII letters and digits; every other character is a separator.
2. Every returned word is lowercased.
3. An input containing no words (empty string, or only separators) returns an empty array.
4. A non-string input throws a TypeError whose message names the offending type.

Tests live in tests/util.test.js using node:test and node:assert/strict. Cover all four criteria.

tasks.name: Slug generation
tasks.spec:
Create src/slug.js as an ES module exporting a named function slugify(input).

Acceptance criteria:
1. slugify(input) returns the words of input, as produced by the words function imported from ./util.js, joined with single hyphens. It MUST import and use words from ./util.js rather than re-implementing the logic.
2. An input with no words returns the empty string.
3. A non-string input throws TypeError (propagated from words; do not catch it).

Tests live in tests/slug.test.js using node:test and node:assert/strict. Cover all three criteria, including that 'Hello, World!' becomes 'hello-world'."}]}

tasks.name: Word-boundary truncation
tasks.spec:
Create src/truncate.js as an ES module exporting a named function truncateWords(input, maxWords).

Acceptance criteria:
1. truncateWords uses the words function imported from ./util.js (it MUST NOT re-implement word splitting) and returns the first maxWords words of input joined by single spaces.
2. If input contains more than maxWords words, the result ends with '...' appended directly to the last word (no space before it).
3. If input contains maxWords words or fewer, all words are returned with no ellipsis.
4. If maxWords is not a positive integer (zero, negative, fractional, or not a number), throw a RangeError.

Tests live in tests/truncate.test.js using node:test and node:assert/strict. Cover all four criteria.
